patch_description:
This redesign replaces the long single-trajectory coordinate walk with a deterministic population-based constraint-exchange search. It retains the unit-square hull anchors, so normalized minimum area equals raw minimum triangle area, but explores many qualitatively different arrangements simultaneously.

The main search uses a differential-evolution style population whose selection criterion transitions from a smooth lower-tail objective to strict max-min triangle area. This lets early iterations escape lattice basins while late iterations optimize the actual evaluation metric. The best population members are then polished using dense deterministic coordinate rings with lexicographic lower-tail tie-breaking, preserving the strict bottleneck while improving nearby active constraints.
